name: WebEngine Presentation
purpose: define stable semantic hooks for WebEngine application and composition structure without owning visual styling

publicClasses..we-section: section-level composition container inside a page

semantics.data-state: runtime or presentation lifecycle state carrier when the owning subsystem defines such states
semantics.data-status: semantic status carrier when the owning subsystem defines status values
semantics.data-variant: presentation/composition variant carrier when a dedicated structural class is unnecessary
semantics.aria-current: standards-based current-item/current-page state for navigation and equivalent current-context projections
semantics.native disabled state: native disabled semantics for actual native controls where applicable

rules: attribute names are stable presentation carriers; their value vocabularies belong to the subsystem contract that owns the represented state
this contract does not create renderer lifecycle states, domain statuses or business variants
aria-current must be used according to platform accessibility semantics
native disabled semantics are preferred over CSS-only disabled appearance for native controls

WebEngine: shared state carrier semantics listed by this contract
Style: layout, spacing, color, typography and other visual properties

rules: .we-* describes shared application/composition semantics, never domain business meaning
Style may consume .we-* and semantic state attributes but must not redefine their meaning
WebEngine must not encode visual appearance into class names or state values
WebGUI .wg-* remains the independent namespace for generic DOM/UI primitive semantics
a domain may compose .we-* structures but must not create a conflicting shared meaning for an existing .we-* class
domain-specific classes may coexist in domain-owned renderers, but shared Style must not depend on them
presentation state is not authorization authority
class presence, absence or visual state must never be treated as proof of authorization
